title: Probationary SLO gating and auto-calibrated circuit-breaker for regional model pinning
creator: Riley Chen
description: Introduce a probationary SLO gating mechanism and an auto-calibrated circuit-breaker to safely pin model variants during cross-region failover. The goal is to allow short-lived model pinning for performance or compliance reasons while bounding risk to global SLOs via automated probation windows, adaptive circuit thresholds, and controlled error-budget borrowing. This ticket defines policy, metrics, algorithms, tests, and rollout steps for the feature.
acceptance_criteria: A probation window implementation exists: configurable duration (default 10m) and scoring window (default 5m) per endpoint-model pair.
Auto-calibrated circuit-breaker computes thresholds from rolling quantiles and request-mix signals and can open/close without manual tuning.
Error-budget borrowing for probationary pins is enforced: per-variant temporary borrow cap (default 20% of monthly error budget) and automatic payback schedule (default 72h).
Integration tests covering a) normal traffic, b) KV-cache warmup regressions, c) regional ejection followed by probationary pinning, and d) borrowed-budget repayment. All tests pass in CI.
Runbook and console views added: per-pin probation status, borrowed budget ledger, and recommended mitigations in Console-2026.03 dashboard.
Canary rollout exercised on non-critical routes with telemetry validating no >5% monthly burn rate delta in test region compared to baseline.

decisions: Probation window defaults: 10m duration, 5m scoring window (approved by PM on 2026-02-28).
Borrowing policy: per-variant borrow cap 20% of monthly error budget with linear payback over 72 hours. Borrowing subject to global safety check to prevent cumulative borrow > 50% of tenant budget.
Circuit calibration: use rolling p50/p90/p95 quantile baselines with an adaptive multiplier based on recent traffic variance (multiplier = 1 + min(0.5, 0.25 * traffic_cv)).
KV-cache warmup signal: include per-tenant KV-hit-rate and cache-age decays; probation scoring reduces penalty while cache-age < warmup_threshold (default 2m).
Open/close hysteresis: require 3 consecutive scoring windows above threshold to open circuit and 2 consecutive windows below to close.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (dev): unit tests + local sim harness (complete).
Phase 1 (staging): enable on low-traffic routes in staging region A; monitor borrowed_budget ledger and p95 deltas for 72h (ETA 2026-03-15).
Phase 2 (canary): enable on 5% of production traffic for non-critical tenants; run for 7d and validate no >5% relative monthly burn change. If metrics stable, expand.
Phase 3 (general): enable by default with opt-out via route config. Publish runbook and SRE playbook.
test_plan: Unit tests for threshold calculator and borrowing ledger (CI).
Integration test: synthetic traffic with KV-cache cold start to validate probation reduces false positives.
Chaos test: simulate regional ejection and ensure pinned variant enters probation, borrower ledger updated, and global SLO preserved.
Load test: 10k rps sustained with mixed route token lengths; validate circuit behavior under burst and sustained load.
monitoring: Telemetry metrics to add: probation_status{route,variant,region}, borrowed_budget_ratio{tenant,variant}, probation_score, kv_cache_age, kv_hit_rate, circuit_state{open,half-open,closed}.
Alerts: borrowed_budget_ratio > 0.8 for 1h => P1 alert to SRE; circuit open for >30m on high-priority route => P0 alert.
Dashboards: Console view showing live probation ledgers, per-variant borrow history, and simulated payback forecast.
notes: Algorithm sketch: compute probation_score = weighted(sum(metric_excess / baseline), weights) where metric_excess = max(0, observed - baseline_target). Baseline_target derived from rolling median and historical seasonality window (24h).
Simulations indicate conservative multiplier prevents premature circuit opens for traffic spikes caused by client-side retries; still need to tune for long-tail conversational routes.
Follow-up work: add tenant-priority overrides for enterprise customers with explicit approval flow and auditing (separate ticket).
Related doc: tie this policy to per-route SLI declarations so probation gating respects route-specific fidelity bands.
